workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the times when both are free for a 30-minute meeting:

- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Could you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars to see which of these slots work for them? Let me know their availability for these specific times.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against the slots you provided. Unfortunately, NONE of the proposed times work for both Elena and David:

- Monday 9:00-10:00: Both Elena and David are busy 9:00-10:00.
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Both Elena and David are busy 13:00-14:00.
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Both Elena (Hiring panel) and David (Travel) are busy.
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: David is busy 15:00-16:00 (Partner lunch, then Busy). Elena is free 15:00-15:30 but busy 15:30-16:00.
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy (Hiring panel). David is free.
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Both Elena and David are busy 11:00-12:00.

Since the slots you listed are the only times Priya and Marcus are both free, and none of those work for Elena and David, it appears there is no time next week when all four partners can meet. 

Should I call report_infeasible, or would you like to double-check Priya and Marcus's calendars to confirm there are no other overlapping free times?

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
